title: How to (Accidentally) Meet Your Rich 🚩 Desi Spouse in London. Tip #1
body: Ask which part of London and the whole thing sorts itself. "Ilford" is a starting point. "Chigwell" means the family made it and everyone in Ilford knows exactly when. "Hertfordshire" means they left the community geographically and are still on every WhatsApp group. It's a sealed deal if they say "we're out in Radlett now" slightly apologetically.
caption:
Tip #1 😭 Ilford to Chigwell is the whole journey.
